gate_rule: C2 Gate PASS requires every criterion deterministically satisfying; any undetermined/partial/no keeps the gate FAIL and C2 stays NOT_SUPPORTED (C1 remains PASS). No time-proximity/tool-name/argument-similarity linkage guessing is permitted.

evidence_layers.static_sdk_source: pinned openclaw@2026.6.6 d.ts declarations and dist bundle source of the host dispatch/emit path
evidence_layers.in_process_harness: drives the real SDK hook runner through the public plugin-sdk/plugin-runtime surface (test/after-tool-call-spike.test.mjs)
evidence_layers.in_process_host_path: drives the real host-side execution chain exported by plugin-sdk/agent-harness (wrapToolWithBeforeToolCallHook, runBeforeToolCallHook, runAgentHarnessAfterToolCallHook) without an LLM (scripts/openclaw-after-tool-call-spike.mjs)
evidence_layers.not_applicable: no probe applies within the spike scope

live_gateway_deviation: An isolated live Gateway cannot deterministically answer the spike questions: POST /tools/invoke runs runBeforeToolCallHook but never emits after_tool_call, and the agent harness tool loop that emits after observations requires a live model turn. The in_process_host_path layer exercises the exact exported host functions that loop uses instead; the main checkout's real profile and Gateway were never touched.

questions.question: after_tool_call exists on the pinned OpenClaw SDK/runtime
questions.evidence_ref: PLUGIN_HOOK_NAMES includes after_tool_call; hook-types d.ts declares (event: PluginHookAfterToolCallEvent, ctx: PluginHookToolContext) => Promise<void> | void; harness registers and drives the real runner

questions.question: actual TypeScript type/fields of the handler input
questions.evidence_ref: PluginHookAfterToolCallEvent = { toolName: string; params: Record<string, unknown>; runId?: string; toolCallId?: string; result?: unknown; error?: string; durationMs?: number }; PluginHookToolContext = { agentId?; sessionKey?; sessionId?; runId?; trace?; toolName; toolKind?; toolInputKind?; toolCallId?; getSessionExtension?; channelId? }; host-path probe observed exactly these fields

questions.question: event.toolCallId / ctx.toolCallId are provided stably
questions.evidence_ref: host execution chain supplies the same caller-provided toolCallId on both event and ctx in every scenario (allow/failure/deny/rewrite); both tool execution entry points (wrapped agent tool, /tools/invoke) generate and propagate toolCallId; the d.ts optional marker only reflects optional chaining at call sites

questions.question: toolCallId identical between before_tool_call and after_tool_call
questions.evidence_ref: scenario allow_success/deny_block/multi_plugin_rewrite: before handler, real execute, and after handler all observed the identical toolCallId; emit path derives after toolCallId from the same harness item.id

questions.question: result shape on the success path
questions.evidence_ref: after event.result is the tool return value passed through unchanged (opaque unknown); present on success, absent on throw; blocked path carries the host-built blocked result object

questions.question: error/throw path still triggers after_tool_call
questions.evidence_ref: scenario tool_failure: execute threw, host propagated the error, and the after observation fired with error set and result absent

questions.question: error field and duration field semantics
questions.evidence_ref: error is a bounded string (itemToolError/host String(err)); durationMs is a number derived from the host execution timer on the completed path and undefined on error/blocked observations; success-path durationMs observed as number in scenario allow_success

questions.question: before_tool_call handler completion happens-before tool invocation
questions.evidence_ref: wrapToolWithBeforeToolCallHook awaits runBeforeToolCallHook before calling the real execute; scenario allow_success observed order before_tool_call -> tool_executed -> after_tool_call

questions.question: blocked (block:true) calls still trigger after_tool_call
questions.evidence_ref: scenario deny_block: block:true short-circuits execution (invocation_count=0), the wrapped tool returns the host blocked result as its terminal output, and the after observation fires with that blocked result. Consequence for PR-RTE-03: an after hook firing is NOT proof of invocation; blocked gate states must not produce terminal execution facts (contract 03 §5.2)

questions.question: ordering of after_tool_call relative to tool_result_persist
questions.evidence_ref: tool_result_persist is synchronous on the transcript append hot path; the after observation is scheduled off it via setImmediate; scenario persist_ordering observed before_tool_call -> tool_result_persist -> after_tool_call

questions.question: runtime behavior when an after_tool_call handler throws
questions.evidence_ref: runVoidHook catches per-handler errors under the fail-open policy (logs, does not rethrow) and sibling handlers still run; the hook-helpers wrapper additionally try/catches with a warn log; harness test proves containment with no mutation of tool facts

questions.question: with multiple plugins, are params/result seen by AgentGuard original, pre-rewrite, or final values
questions.evidence_ref: before-chain handlers each see the ORIGINAL params (rewrites merge into the decision only); the real execute receives the adjusted params (recordAdjustedParamsForToolCall); the after event carries the adjusted params when recorded, else startArgs (consumeAdjustedParamsForToolCall); scenario multi_plugin_rewrite observed exactly this

questions.question: can other plugins still rewrite params after approval and before execution
questions.evidence_ref: param rewrites happen only inside the single awaited before_tool_call chain that also carries requireApproval; there is no second rewrite phase between approval release and execute in the pinned host path. Live approval-lifecycle timing was not exercised (requires human approval flow), so the verdict stays partial

questions.question: toolCallId reuse across retries
questions.evidence_ref: /tools/invoke derives toolCallId from the caller idempotencyKey (same key -> same id; no key -> fresh timestamp id); the agent loop assigns per-item ids, so an LLM-level retry is a new item with a new id. A live retry scenario was not exercised, so the verdict stays partial

c2_gate_criteria.evidence_ref: Q03/Q04: identical host-supplied toolCallId observed across before/execute/after in every host-path scenario
Q08: the wrapper awaits the full before chain before the real execute; observed ordering confirms happens-before
Q05/Q06/Q07: success -> result passthrough + numeric durationMs; throw -> bounded string error, no result; blocked -> host blocked result, zero invocation

Q09: blocked call = zero invocation but after hook still fires carrying the blocked result; the rule 'no terminal fact for blocked gate states' is implementable and covered by the spike's deny scenario assertion

c2_gate_criteria.criterion: multi-plugin rewrites do not break security-critical identity
c2_gate_criteria.evidence_ref: Q12: toolCallId identity is host-supplied and untouched by param merges; rewrites flow through the merged decision / adjusted-params channel only; scenario multi_plugin_rewrite confirms identity stability under rewrite
